build_image_encoder: build an ImageEncoder with a trunk backbone and FpnNeck to extract vision features from images
run_image_encoder_forward: run the ImageEncoder forward pass on a tensor sample to get vision features and positional encodings
create_fpn_neck: create an FpnNeck with position encoding and a backbone channel list for feature pyramid processing
run_fpn_neck_forward: run the FpnNeck forward pass on a list of feature tensors to get multi-scale outputs and positions
review_image_encoder_scalp: review the ImageEncoder scalp parameter to discard lowest resolution features from the output
